svg.title: Au–MoS₂ top-contact structures: pristine and two symmetric vacancy positions
svg.desc: Actual atomic coordinates from AuMoS2SBH P, F0, and F10. Gold atoms form five layers above MoS2 at each end of a continuous monolayer. Cartesian x-z view at the same physical scale. Hollow red circles mark the S atoms removed in the corresponding calculation; these circles are not atoms.

g.text: Side view (x–z) · same physical scale in all rows
